\vspace{1.75in}
\begin{center}
This book is dedicated to my beloved husband, Jim,\\
whose love filled my life with joy, laughter, and deep companionship for 60 years.\\

\vspace{0.25in}
After Jim's death, when grief felt overwhelming, it was my dear friends and family who gently helped bring me back to life again. They called me, listened to me, checked on me, and cared about how I was doing. Their kindness, week after week, lifted my spirits more than they may ever know.\\

\vspace{0.25in}
I am deeply grateful for their love and friendship.\\

\end{center}
